name: Scolding Administrator
oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Repartee — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
When this creature dies, if it had counters on it, put those counters on up to one target creature.
blocked_sentences: Repartee — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter clause (e.g. `targets: {types: ["Creature"]}` in the trigger `filter`) that matches the cast spell by what it targets, evaluated once when the trigger is collected and not re-checked on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only way to read a cast spell's targets is the `spell_targets` binding inside a trigger `condition` (Orvar, the All-Form), but a condition is an intervening-if that 603.4 re-checks on resolution: if the targeted creature leaves in response, the printed Repartee trigger still gives the counter while the condition form does nothing. `trigger_filter_keys` has no clause about a spell's targets, and `targeted_by` belongs to the per-permanent becomes_target event.
